content.value: Yesterday the price of CD was Tk. 30 per piece and Karim was willing to buy 5 10 pieces. Today, the price has gone up to Tk. 40 per piece and Karim is now willing to buy 2 pieces.
(i) Estimate Karim's elasticity of demand for CD. (ii) Is Karim's demand for CD elastic or inelastic?
